questions.question: Use calculate_correlation in order to know What is the relationship between sugar content and calorie count in Starbucks beverages?

answer.value: There is a strong positive correlation between sugar content and calorie count in Starbucks beverages. As sugar content increases, calorie count tends to increase as well, with some variation across different beverage categories

key_insights: Strong positive correlation between sugar and calories
Different beverage categories show varying levels of sugar and calories
Smoothies and Frappuccinos tend to have higher sugar and calorie content
